items.title: File Berkeley County business personal property return
items.authority: Berkeley County County Auditor or SC Department of Revenue
items.description: South Carolina business personal property returns are due the last day of the fourth month after the accounting period closes (April 30 for calendar-year filers), to the county auditor or, for retail and sales-tax businesses, the SCDOR. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File Charleston County business personal property return
items.description: South Carolina business personal property returns are due the last day of the fourth month after the accounting period closes (April 30 for calendar-year filers), to the county auditor or, for retail and sales-tax businesses, the SCDOR.

note: Charleston County's Revenue Collections Division collects a 2% local accommodations fee (Ordinance 910), also on behalf of the cities of Charleston, North Charleston and Folly Beach, but its return due date was not found.

items.title: File the Horry County lodging tax return
items.description: Accommodations remittance forms and payment are due by the 20th of the month after the reporting period (monthly, quarterly or yearly per account); a zero return must still be signed and mailed. Register your account with the Hospitality Fee Department (843-915-5620); unincorporated short-term rentals also need a county business license and the state forms ST-388, ST-3T and ST-389.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental
